narrationTexts: Confirms the bug: `orderTotal` taxes the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted one.
finalText:
**Suite is green: 625 passing, 0 failing.**

`orderTotal` in [src/pricing.js:41](src/pricing.js:41) taxed the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted one, so any row with both a discount and a tax rate came out wrong. That's why only the `order totals` suite (3 cases) failed.

Fixed by taxing `discounted` instead of `cents`.

Next: nothing.
